title: Android Zero-Root Execution Engine (Shizuku + rish)
content: Zero-root hardware and UI control architecture running locally on POCO C85 Termux under UID 2000 (Shell) via Shizuku and rish. Employs uiautomator dump for sub-second XML node hierarchy parsing (eliminating expensive multimodal OCR), paired with input tap, input text, and screencap -p. Termux API provides direct notifications, SMS interception, battery states, and clipboard reads.

title: Safety Boundary & Pending Ledger (Human-in-the-Loop)
content: High-stakes actions (money transfers, bank interactions, irreversible deletions, device locks) are intercepted before execution and staged in a pending ledger state. Execution strictly halts at biometric authentication and Android FLAG_SECURE boundaries, requiring physical human confirmation on the device.

title: 100% Free Keepalive Matrix (Render + Supabase)
content: cron-job.org Job A fires an HTTP ping every 10-12 minutes to the Render backend /internal/ping endpoint. The route responds with 200 OK immediately in-memory with zero DB overhead, keeping Render awake 24/7 without exceeding the 750 free monthly instance hours. Job B executes a lightweight Supabase query once every 24 hours, completely eliminating the 7-day Supabase inactivity database pause rule.
